hooks.command: P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" session-start || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks session-start || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks session-start || true; fi; exit 0

P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" post-compaction || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks post-compaction || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks post-compaction || true; fi; exit 0

P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" prompt-submit || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks prompt-submit || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks prompt-submit || true; fi; exit 0

P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" post-tool || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks post-tool || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks post-tool || true; fi; exit 0

P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" stop || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks stop || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks stop || true; fi; exit 0

P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" permission || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks permission || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks permission || true; fi; exit 0
